build_vilt_image_processor: build a ViltImageProcessor instance to preprocess images for the VILT vision-language model
resize_vilt_images: resize a batch of images to a specified shortest edge while preserving aspect ratio and applying a size divisor
pad_vilt_image_batch: pad a batch of differently-sized images to the maximum dimensions and generate corresponding pixel masks
preprocess_vilt_images: preprocess a batch of images by resizing, rescaling, normalizing, and optionally padding for model input
test_vilt_image_processor_kwargs: test the ViltImageProcessorKwargs configuration class for optional size_divisor parameter validation
